freeTierSummary.en: Free hosted inference endpoints for 100+ models on build.nvidia.com, OpenAI-compatible. No credit card; phone/email verification required. The main limit is about 40 requests per minute. Model IDs may change; check the official catalog.
freeTierSummary.zh-CN: build.nvidia.com 提供上百个模型的免费托管推理入口，OpenAI 兼容，免信用卡，需手机号/邮箱验证。主要限制约 40 请求/分钟。模型 ID 可能调整，以官网 catalog 为准。
